gen-gf-oxanium-gf-hind-guntur: Hind Guntur is a plain sans with tall lowercase and gaps where its curves meet the stems, like stamped metal type. Under Oxanium's commanding display look, it feels sturdy and quiet.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-hind-madurai: Oxanium's monoline strokes and oversized lowercase give the heading a distinctive, machined confidence, with curves that end in clear daylight. Hind Madurai follows in friendly sans-serif, its letters filling the line.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-hind-mysuru: Contemporary is the mood Hind Mysuru sets, with lowercase tops pressed up close to the ascender height. Hind Mysuru stays businesslike while Oxanium, the commanding display face above it, supplies the drama.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-hind-siliguri: Sharp, techy, a bit stubborn. Oxanium is best at making a loud, distinctive statement with its uninterrupted lines, while Hind Siliguri is best at a steady gray hum of constant line weight in running text.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-hind-vadodara: Oxanium leads with commanding, monoline strokes and a high x-height that makes its lowercase look oversized and distinctive. Hind Vadodara sits below it, spacious and clean in its rounded forms.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-huninn: Huninn reads modern and businesslike, its lowercase bodies rising close to cap height and its s terminals held clear of the body. Make Oxanium small and its commanding presence thins out.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-inter-tight: Oxanium opens with a commanding, distinctive display look. Inter Tight is a plain sans with short ascenders and curve tails held back, so a long passage stays smooth and compact.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-karla: Big lowercase, hard edges. Oxanium's curves carry no stress at all, and Karla's gaping c opening and tall middle band make a long stretch of it read sturdy and friendly.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-kedebideri: Kedebideri reads approachable, with a skyward x-height line and rounded letters that stay open and inviting. Oxanium does commanding best, its diagonals as heavy as its verticals, while Kedebideri simply stays low-key.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-khula: Stencil-cut letters of one steady width make Oxanium distinctive and commanding, with oversized lowercase to match. Khula takes the quieter job as a modern sans, its open curves and tall midsection holding up when the body size goes up a notch.
